facts.anchor: Georgia was right. Monday was really quiet, and after last week, it felt too quiet.
facts.fact: Georgia 说对了：周一的店安静得反常。

facts.anchor: At least I had time to enter reorders and call Roddie’s school in Toronto.
facts.fact: 空出来的时间她用来处理补货与给多伦多的 Roddie 学校打电话。

facts.anchor: I was perched on the stool at the cash desk, working on my laptop, when Zak burst in with his usual bull-in-a-china-shop energy.
facts.fact: Zak 带着 bull-in-a-china-shop 的闯入劲冲进店里，她正坐在收银台高脚凳上用笔记本。

facts.anchor: “I brought this for the cabinet.” He held up a rag and a capped bottle. “Sometimes a little rub with oil is all it needs, rather than a full strip and finish.”
facts.fact: 他掏钱包说要买「模拟口爱」并自曝有钱（婚礼钱），被 Meg 直接打断。

facts.anchor: For a long moment, the innuendo hung in the air.
facts.fact: 他坦白与 Erica 差点结婚：同居三年（她护士、他做技术）、她不肯搬来、他圣诞节后辞职回家照顾父亲。

facts.anchor: He nodded. “You’re right. It’s the store.”
facts.fact: Meg 给出判词：分手与离婚本身不算失败，关系由无数小成功小失败组成，不能整体盖章。

facts.anchor: I smirked, closed the laptop, and folded my arms on the desk.
facts.fact: 她自陈：认识他们的人会说她的婚姻成功，但内部她总把自己排在最后——「Our marriage was really only successful for him.」

facts.anchor: “Need me to stop the music?” Air Supply was “All Out of Love.”
facts.fact: 她把离婚称为成功（civil、Joel 没为抚养权上法庭），并说明她的红线：绝不为一个男孩再跨国一次。
